CORE MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 9
   C. 1
   D. 21

2. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 24
   C. 48
   D. 144

3. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 121
   C. 22
   D. 122

4. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 24
   C. 42
   D. 36

5. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 17
   C. 13
   D. 7

6. Solve for x: x + 4 = 11. (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 8
   C. 4
   D. 7

7. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 40

8. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 82
   C. 81
   D. 18

9. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 4
   C. 32
   D. 12

10. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 32
   C. 33
   D. 4

11. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 73
   C. 72
   D. 17

12. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 90
   C. 18
   D. 81

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
